summary: QIAGEN N.V. filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, furnishing a press release with preliminary Q1 2026 results and an updated full-year 2026 outlook. Net sales were $492 million (up 2% reported, down 1% CER); adjusted diluted EPS was $0.54, meeting guidance. The company revised its 2026 net sales growth outlook to ~1-2% CER (from at least 5%) and adjusted EPS to at least $2.43 CER (from at least $2.50), citing lower QuantiFERON immigration testing demand and cautious U.S. Life Sciences demand. This is a routine earnings update with no special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review.
